How every install runs

The same routine on a Mehran or a Land Cruiser. Nothing is skipped to save time.

  1. Inspect

    We check the paint for chips, swirls and old repairs under studio lighting.

  2. Decontaminate

    Foam wash, clay and iron removal lift everything the film would otherwise trap.

  3. Correct

    Compounding removes swirls so the film locks in a clean finish, not the defects.

  4. Install

    Film is fitted panel by panel, with edges wrapped wherever the panel allows.

  5. Hand over

    We inspect every edge, walk you through aftercare and hand back the keys.

Before you book

PPF or ceramic coating: which one do I need?

PPF is a physical film that takes the hit from stone chips and scratches. Ceramic coating is a hard, water-repelling layer for gloss and easy cleaning. Many owners do both: film on high-impact panels, coating on top.

Which film brand should I choose?

We install Kevlar, Nanotek, Nanolink, Nanospark and Starkx, all USA films. Tell us your budget and whether you want gloss or matte, and we will recommend the right one.

How long will my car be at the studio?

It depends on the car, its paint condition and how much coverage you choose. We confirm the exact timeline on WhatsApp before you drop the car off.

Are you really open 24 hours?

Yes. Both studios are open 24 hours, seven days a week. Booking ahead guarantees a bay and an installer ready for your car.

How can I pay?

The Johar studio accepts credit cards, debit cards and NFC mobile payments. The Saadi Town studio accepts credit cards, digital transfers and offers installment options.
